title: [AdvancedChatLog] Simply Updated
description: An update of the original AdvancedChatLog(With fixes). A simple way to filter and view mass amounts of Minecraft messages
body:
# AdvancedChatLog
THIS IS AN UPDATED PORT FROM THE [ORIGINAL](https://modrinth.com/mod/advancedchatlog) BY [DarkKronicle](https://modrinth.com/user/DarkKronicle)!

AdvancedChatLog lets you view and search through the chat history, beyond what Minecraft usually lets you view

Please submit bugs to the [issue tracker](https://github.com/Nordes314/AdvancedChatLog/issues).
## Dependencies

[[AdvancedChatCore] Simply Updated](https://modrinth.com/mod/advancedchatcore-simply-updated) is required to run the mod.
## Features

- View chat history beyond the vanilla Minecraft limit of 100 lines
- Search through chat history using RegEx, literal, and case-insensitive (UpperLower)
- Retain chat history across relaunching
- Smooth Scrolling
- Separate chat log file
